define.lead.zh:text: 新质生产力由技术革命性突破、生产要素创新性配置、产业深度转型升级而催生。它的核心，是生产要素从「量的堆叠」转向「质的跃迁」——而人工智能，恰好同时改写了生产力的三个基本要素。
define.lead.en:text: New quality productive forces arise from revolutionary technological breakthroughs, innovative allocation of production factors and deep industrial transformation. Their essence is a shift from quantitative stacking to qualitative leaps — and AI rewrites all three basic factors of productivity at once.
